import statistics
import time
import numpy as np
from lubridate import *
from timechange.civil import Posixct
from datetime import datetime, timezone
x = Posixct(datetime(2009, 9, 2, tzinfo=timezone.utc).timestamp(), "UTC")
y = Posixct(1268532305, "UTC")

    return float(day_set(x, 15).seconds)

    started = time.perf_counter(); one(); elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)

import statistics
import time
import numpy as np
from lubridate import *
from timechange.civil import Posixct
from datetime import datetime, timezone
x = Posixct(datetime(2009, 9, 2, tzinfo=timezone.utc).timestamp(), "UTC")
y = Posixct(1268532305, "UTC")
def one():
    return float(with_tz(y, "America/New_York").seconds)
warm = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter(); one(); elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
print("%.17g" % statistics.median(elapsed))
got = [float(with_tz(y, "America/New_York").seconds)]
print(" ".join("%.17g" % float(v) for v in got))
